description: Ring 2 correctly sits on the mouth of the close-up figure, who carries both VARMA lines. He is off-model for the king, though. He has no white-and-red namam on his forehead, and his moustache is thick and heavily curled, Nagoji-style, rather than Varma's thin waxed one. His hair is slightly wavy. Only the pearl ear-drops and the gold bead necklace identify him as Varma, so readers could take him for Nagoji.
where_the_speaker_is: Close-up face, centre of panel (the only figure)

description: Ring 2 correctly sits on the mouth of the close-up figure, who carries both VARMA lines. The namam, pearl drop and straight sleek hair all match Varma. His moustache, though, is drawn thick and heavily curled at the ends, like Nagoji's, not as Varma's thin waxed moustache with sharp points. This is a minor off-model moustache, not a full identity swap.

The ring for VARMA's line ('You know guns...') sits correctly on the seated king, who has the namam and gold necklaces. But this Varma is off-model. He has a thick handlebar moustache with curled ends and loose, wavy-to-curly hair with flyaway curls at the back. There is no sleek side knot and no visible pearl drop. That drifts toward Nagoji's thick curled moustache and curly hair. In p09.04 and p10.02 of the same chapter he is on-model, with sleek hair, a side knot, a thin waxed moustache and pearl drops.
who_the_tail_points_at: Varma (seated king, right of the balloon), ring at his mouth
where_the_speaker_is: Same seated figure; the ring is on the right man, but his face and hair do not match the Varma sheet

description: The shared ring for DE LANNOY's two Dutch balloons is correctly on the blond De Lannoy's mouth. But he leans over Donnadi's head, and the drawn tail of balloon 1 is cut short. Its tip ends on the crown of Donnadi's dark hair, just under De Lannoy's nose. Balloon 2's tail also stops on the back of Donnadi's head and neck. A reader could take the first line ('Joseph. Look around you...') as Donnadi's. The tail should end on or touch De Lannoy's face, or the balloon should come in from his side.
who_the_tail_points_at: The drawn tail tip lands on Donnadi's hair (crown); the ring itself is on De Lannoy's mouth
where_the_speaker_is: De Lannoy, the blond young officer at left, leaning in at Donnadi's ear

description: The ring and tail are on the only face in the panel, which is correct. But this VARMA has long loose curly hair, a thick curled handlebar moustache, and a horizontal white forehead band with a red dot where his vertical namam should be. Without the pearl earring and gold beads he would read as Nagoji from the commander sheet, and Nagoji's bandaged arm is also in the frame.
where_the_speaker_is: Centre-left close-up of the man with pearl earring and gold beads (the ring sits on his mouth)
who_the_tail_points_at: That same man (correct target, but drawn off-model)

description: VARMA's ring is on the seated man at far left. He has loose shoulder-length curly hair, a full moustache and no namam showing. He sits right next to Nagoji (topknot, grey streak), so the two men look alike, and a reader could take the curly-haired speaker for Nagoji.
where_the_speaker_is: Seated man at far left of the foreground pair
who_the_tail_points_at: Seated man at far left (intended Varma)

description: Varma speaks both balloons 1 and 2 with his back to the viewer, and the ring correctly sits by his ear and pearl earring. Seen from behind, his hair is a mass of black curls in a loose bun, not the sleek straight hair on his sheet. Since hair is the main cue in a back view, he reads like Nagoji's curls.
where_the_speaker_is: Foreground figure at left, seen from behind
who_the_tail_points_at: Back of that figure's head, by the pearl earring

description: Varma speaks balloons 2 and 3, and the ring correctly sits on the left man's mouth. But Varma is drawn with tousled loose wavy hair and horizontal white forehead stripes with a red dot instead of the vertical namam with a red centre line. Only the pearl earring and gold beads mark him as the king.
where_the_speaker_is: Standing man at left, hand raised
who_the_tail_points_at: Same man (correct target, but drawn off-model)

description: VARMA's ring correctly sits on the left man, but he has wavy loose hair, a thick moustache with curled tips and no namam (only a cut on his forehead). Facing Nagoji, who has curly hair, a topknot and a full moustache, the two read close. Only the pearl earring versus Nagoji's silver chain and grey streak tells them apart.
where_the_speaker_is: Seated man at left with pearl earring and forehead cut
